title: Türkiye 2026 fon vakası (portföy yönetim şirketleri fonları / düşük fiili dolaşımlı hisseler)

reported_trigger_regulatory.what: reported SPK rule limiting the sum of large (>5%) positions in funds

reported_event.what: reported SPK decision to liquidate 131 funds of seven portfolio management companies

event_facts.note: Dates are as REPORTED by the press; the exact timestamps, entities and the observable precursor series must be taken from SPK/TEFAS/KAP primary data before any replay. Nothing about the outcome is used as a model input.

healthy_controls.rule: all funds of the same category/period not named in the SPK decision, at least 100

unobservable_pre_event: the regulatory rule change itself (exogenous): SFRE can only measure fragility (concentration, free-float exposure, illiquidity, overlap), not forecast regulation
fund leverage / derivative / repo exposure (not public)

scoring.RELEASE_FAILURE: coverage >= min_required_coverage AND no alarm on any event entity before event_time
scoring.FALSE_ALARM_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: alarm on event entity but healthy-control false-alarm rate exceeds the budget
scoring.BLOCKED_NO_DATA: required precursor coverage below minimum or event facts not confirmed (NOT a pass)
scoring.PASSED: only on REAL data: caught before event_time AND within false-alarm budget

event_entities_status: UNOBSERVED: entity list must be supplied from SPK primary publication
